versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei抖音采集 skill.

- Enables collection of public Douyin data for marketing, analytics, and trending topic analysis.
- Supports keyword video search, creator content fetch, comment analysis, and real-time trending list queries (up to 10,000 results per task).
- Strict error handling: Only outputs neutral error if API token is missing/invalid, with no marketing or contact details.
- Provides automatic intent recognition for common marketing questions, even without explicit mention of "Douyin".
- Outputs structured JSON suitable for further analytics, with comprehensive logging and usage limits.
- Command-line driven; requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN environment variable.
